🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad participation led by Healthcare (multiple names ABOVE TREND) while Technology shows concentrated weakness in mega-caps (many BELOW TREND), and Leadership is Narrow (Top 5: 5/5 Healthcare).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate strong: WELL (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND, VTR (1W: +9.13% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing pickup: CAT (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -14.41%) BELOW TREND. Materials soft: DOW (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Healthcare).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Tech/Materials and select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND — Major divergence: broad Healthcare momentum vs. large-cap Tech declines (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT BELOW TREND) — tactical risk to regime confidence.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with concentrated large-cap weakness; NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND — Sector showing internal rotation and dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed-to-firm; JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.75% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND — broadly resilient and supportive of risk but not leading.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare leadership clear and broad: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND — sector strength is the primary market driver.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Healthcare leaders (ABBV, JNJ, LLY) and selective Industrials/Financials showing ABOVE TREND continuation; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech laggards (NVDA, AAPL, ORCL) until trend confirmation. Style: Defensive/Value tilt given narrow Healthcare leadership and Tech dispersion.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -16.24% | 1M: -18.56%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +7.05%) — momentum needs monitoring. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62%) — watch for spillover from mega-cap weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor NVDA: failure to stabilize after 1W -8.62% would extend Tech weakness; AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) holding 1M downtrend is critical for Consumer risk; JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) breakout continuation would confirm Financials strength.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): EMA backing for Jaypirca; price confirming as LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND. ABBV (+60): Health Canada approval; ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. IBM (+60): chip/quantum announcements; IBM (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND — confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-60): CFO departure/clinical miss; PFE (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -7.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. META (-45): restrictions on Gemini usage; META (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -13.30%) BELOW TREND — confirming. AAPL (-45): downgrade; AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND — confirming. Note QCOM (+60 news) is a divergence: QCOM (1W: -16.24% | 1M: -18.56%) BELOW TREND despite bullish headlines — distribution signal.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Defensive/Value tilt; breadth healthy (8/11) but leadership is narrow and concentrated in Healthcare. ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: broad Tech mega-cap weakness (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT BELOW TREND) and headline/price divergences (QCOM bullish news but price BELOW TREND) — watch for trend breaks.
